changes.name: DirectionalIslandExpansion
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

-- Each upgrade adds ONE connected outer layer around the starter island.
-- WEST/left is intentionally left open for the upgrade signs.
local folder=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions") or Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="DirectionalExpansions";folder.Parent=world
folder:ClearAllChildren()

-- Hide old expansion pieces that caused disconnected platforms.
for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
 if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Name=="Expansion1" or v.Name=="Expansion2" or v.Name=="Bridge" or v.Name=="TreasureIsland") then
  v.Transparency=1;v.CanCollide=false
 end
end

local layers={}
local function makePart(name,size,pos,layer)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos-Vector3.new(0,10,0)
 p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.Transparency=1
 p.Material=Enum.Material.Grass;p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(102,190,105)
 p.Parent=folder
 table.insert(layers[layer],{part=p,target=pos})
end

-- Starter island is about 54x54. Every layer grows NORTH, EAST and SOUTH,
-- plus corner pieces so the result reads as one continuous island.
-- The WEST edge stays clear for the floating upgrade boards.
for layer=1,9 do
 layers[layer]={}
 local step=14
 local outer=27+layer*step
 local inner=27+(layer-1)*step
 local depth=step
 local center=(inner+outer)/2
 local span=outer*2

 makePart("L"..layer.."_North",Vector3.new(span,3,depth),Vector3.new(0,18.5,-center),layer)
 makePart("L"..layer.."_South",Vector3.new(span,3,depth),Vector3.new(0,18.5,center),layer)
 makePart("L"..layer.."_East",Vector3.new(depth,3,math.max(1,span-depth*2)),Vector3.new(center,18.5,0),layer)
end

local shown={}
local function reveal(layer)
 if shown[layer] or not layers[layer] then return end
 shown[layer]=true
 for i,info in ipairs(layers[layer]) do
  task.delay((i-1)*.07,function()
   local p=info.part
   if not p.Parent then return end
   p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true
   TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.65,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=info.target}):Play()
  end)
 end
end

local function hook(player)
 local stage=player:WaitForChild("IslandStage")
 for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,9) do reveal(i) end
 stage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
  for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,9) do reveal(i) end
 end)
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hook,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)

print("Connected wraparound island expansion loaded")
